privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: SOUK-SCAN helps people across Morocco see what food really costs (Android app com.soukscan.app). This page explains, in plain words, what the app and this website do with your information and the choices you have. We only ask for what the app needs to work, and we never sell your data. If you have a question or a request, just write to sanamdev@soukscan.online.
privacy.description: How SOUK-SCAN uses your information: account, shared prices, the Calculator, region, location permission and account deletion, explained simply.

sections.title: What we collect and why
paragraphs: To create your account we need your email address. We also keep your account identifier and the sign-in records needed to keep your account secure. If you sign in with Google, Google may share basic profile information with our sign-in provider. We note which version of the terms you accepted.

When you share a price, we save the product, the price, your region, the date and your account identifier, so that you can find and manage your own prices. If you send us feedback, we save the category, your message and your account identifier. If you use the Calculator, we save what you enter there (more below).

We use this information to run your account, show community prices, keep SOUK-SCAN safe and fair for everyone (for example by spotting bots, spam, misuse and attempts to manipulate prices), and make the app better.

sections.title: Your location
paragraphs: Detecting your region automatically is optional. If you allow it, the app reads your location on your device only to work out which of Morocco’s 12 regions you are in. Your exact GPS coordinates are never sent, saved or logged. You can also simply choose your region yourself.

Your region (detected or chosen) is saved on your device and sent to our servers when you ask for prices in your region or share a price, so that the price is attached to the right region. Your exact location stays on your phone.

sections.title: Your Calculator
paragraphs: The Calculator is a convenience tool that helps you add up your shopping. It is there to help you, not to judge you. For each day you can add shops (you can give a shop a short name, up to 40 characters), the products you buy, the price per kilo (or per egg) and the quantity, in kilos or in pieces for eggs. The app works out the totals on your phone.

We save what you enter on our servers, linked to your account, so you can find it again: the products, prices and quantities you enter, the totals worked out from them, and any shop names you choose (our reports never include shop names). The people who run SOUK-SCAN can see it for each account, only through restricted, logged reports. We look at it to keep SOUK-SCAN fair and safe (for example to spot bots, spam, misuse or attempts to manipulate prices), to improve the app, and to understand what people buy. Other users never see your list. We do not sell it, we do not share it with advertisers or other companies, and we do not use it to judge you. We may also use it in combined, anonymous form (for example, average quantities) to improve the app and to produce statistics.

SOUK-SCAN is built on prices that people share, so a price you enter in the Calculator is also shared as a community price, just like a price you report yourself. Only the product, price, region and date are shared, never your quantities, totals or shop names. Other users see community prices only as combined estimates. If you make a mistake, you can correct the price on the same day.

No signal at the market? No problem. The Calculator keeps a copy on your phone so that it works without a connection, and sends your entries when you are back online. A list that reaches us a little late is still accepted for up to two days. You can edit a list on the day you make it; after that it is read-only. Please use one phone at a time. If you uninstall the app or clear its data before your entries have been sent, they will be lost. When you sign out, the copy is removed from your phone (the app checks with you first if something has not been sent yet).
You are in control: you decide whether to use the Calculator, and you must accept the current terms before it stores anything. If you delete your account, your Calculator lists are deleted too.

sections.title: Al-Qoffa basket
paragraphs: Al-Qoffa shows a typical basket of everyday food and what it costs. The products, quantities and your choices for a week or a month and for your household stay on your phone only. We never receive them. To show the default basket, the app simply downloads the list we publish, like any other public information.

sections.title: What other users can see
paragraphs: Other users only see combined community estimates. Your email, your identity and your individual prices are not shown to anyone. Your Calculator entries and your Al-Qoffa basket are not shown to other users either. Feedback you send is read only by the people who run SOUK-SCAN. Dated wholesale reference figures, where available, come from a separate public source.

sections.title: News, updates and rating requests
paragraphs: The Info tab shows news we publish. The app gets it from our servers (Supabase), and the pictures load from our own website, <bdi>soukscan.online</bdi>, which is hosted on GitHub Pages. As with any web page, those services can see your device’s internet address. The app keeps the latest news on your phone so that the tab opens without a connection, and remembers the last post you saw so it can show a small dot when there is something new.

When you open the app or come back to it, it checks two public numbers on our servers (the newest version and the oldest version that still works) so it can tell you when an update is available. It remembers on your phone if you dismissed an update message. The update button opens SOUK-SCAN on Google Play, where Google’s own policies apply.

These requests ask for public information only. They include none of your entries or personal details; like all requests to our servers, they carry normal technical information and, when you are signed in, the session token the app uses.

From time to time the app may ask whether you would like to rate it on Google Play. To pick a good moment, it remembers on your phone the days you recently opened the app, when it last asked and your answer. This stays on your phone and is never sent to us. If you choose to rate, Google Play opens and Google’s policies apply.

sections.title: Services that help us run SOUK-SCAN
paragraphs: We use trusted services to run SOUK-SCAN. Supabase provides our database and sign-in. Google handles Google sign-in when you choose it. GitHub Pages hosts this website. Like most online services, they receive technical connection information, such as your IP address, so that they can operate and protect their services.
We do not sell your personal data. SOUK-SCAN shows no ads and uses no advertising or third-party analytics tools, in the app or on this website.

sections.title: What stays on your device
paragraphs: The app saves on your phone your preferences (language, appearance, region, favourites) and the sign-in session that keeps you signed in. It also saves your Al-Qoffa basket choices, a copy of your recent Calculator entries (including any not sent yet), the latest news and the last post you saw, any update message you dismissed, and the state of the rating request. This website saves your language, appearance and region choices in your browser, and sends your region to Supabase to show community estimates. It never asks for your GPS location and never signs you in. You can clear all of this from your phone’s or browser’s storage settings.

sections.title: How long we keep information, and deleting it
paragraphs: We keep your account information, your prices, your Calculator entries, your feedback and your terms-acceptance records for as long as you have an account, unless they are removed earlier. Prices count towards community estimates for a limited recent period; that does not mean the underlying prices are automatically erased afterwards.

You can delete your account whenever you like from Profile → Delete account. This removes your account together with your prices, Calculator entries and feedback. If you prefer, email us from your registered address and we will do it within 30 calendar days. The steps are on the account deletion page.

Our service providers may keep technical logs or backups for a while under their own policies, so deleting your account does not remove every log or backup immediately. Data stored only on your phone, including your Al-Qoffa basket, stays until you clear the app’s or browser’s storage.

sections.title: Keeping your information safe, and your choices
paragraphs: The app talks to our servers over HTTPS, and private account data is protected by access controls tied to your sign-in. No online service can promise perfect security, but we take it seriously. The app never receives your Google password.

You are in charge. You can say no to location access, choose your region yourself, change the language or appearance, choose not to use the Calculator, sign out, or delete your account. To ask about your data or have it corrected, write to sanamdev@soukscan.online.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change how SOUK-SCAN handles information, we update this page and the date at the top. For important changes to this policy or the terms, the app asks you to read and accept the new version before you continue. Release 1.2.0 asks you to accept the updated version once. Questions? Write to sanamdev@soukscan.online.

account-deletion.title: Delete your SOUK-SCAN account
account-deletion.intro: It is your account and your data. You can permanently delete your SOUK-SCAN account, together with the data linked to it, in the app, or ask us to do it by email. This page applies to <bdi>com.soukscan.app</bdi>.
account-deletion.description: Delete your SOUK-SCAN account in the app or request deletion by email. Learn which data is removed and the request timeframe.

sections.title: Delete in the app
paragraphs: Open SOUK-SCAN and sign in. Go to Profile → Delete account, review the information and confirm deletion.

Successful in-app deletion takes effect when the server confirms it. The app then signs you out. If deletion fails, you see an error and can retry. Deletion is permanent. Administrator accounts require assistance from the service maintainers.

sections.title: Request deletion without opening the app
paragraphs: Email sanamdev@soukscan.online from the address registered with your account. Use the subject SOUK-SCAN account deletion request. If you used Google sign-in, write from that Google account’s address. Do not send your password.
We may ask you to confirm that you control the registered email address. We complete valid email deletion requests within 30 calendar days of receipt and reply when deletion is complete.

sections.title: What deletion removes
paragraphs: Deletion removes your active account and sign-in identity, submitted price reports, Calculator entries, feedback and linked terms-acceptance records. Removed reports no longer contribute to estimates computed from the remaining reports. Individual reports and account identities were not displayed publicly.

sections.title: What may remain
paragraphs: Service-provider technical logs and backups, if retained, follow the providers’ retention policies rather than immediate active-account deletion. Preferences and Al-Qoffa basket choices saved only on your device may remain until you clear the app’s storage or browser data.

sections.title: Privacy questions
paragraphs: For questions about deletion or another data request, email sanamdev@soukscan.online. Read the privacy policy for the full description of data handling.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.updated: App terms version: 20 November 2026 · Website updated: 20 November 2026
terms.intro: Welcome to <bdi>SOUK-SCAN</bdi>! These terms explain how to use the app and what to expect from us. <bdi>SOUK-SCAN</bdi> is an information tool that makes food prices in Morocco easier to see and compare. We do not sell products, set or control market prices, guarantee what any seller charges, or run a marketplace, and we are not a government service.
terms.description: The terms for using SOUK-SCAN: sharing prices, using the Calculator, and understanding community and wholesale reference prices.

sections.title: What the prices are
paragraphs: Community prices come from reports shared by people like you. They can be inaccurate, incomplete, out of date or not representative of every shop or market, so they are a helpful guide, not a guarantee. We show a community price only when there are enough recent, valid reports.

sections.title: Reference prices
paragraphs: Where available, wholesale reference prices come from the published bulletins of <bdi>Casa Prestations</bdi> (<bdi>casaprestations.ma</bdi>). Each one shows its source and the date of its bulletin. These are wholesale prices, which are not always the same as retail prices. If a product is missing from the latest bulletin, the app may show its most recent earlier reference, clearly labelled with its date. <bdi>SOUK-SCAN</bdi> is independent: it is not endorsed by, affiliated with or partnered with <bdi>Casa Prestations</bdi>.

sections.title: Sharing prices
paragraphs: When you share a price, please tell us what you really saw or paid. Please do not submit false or misleading prices, try to manipulate averages, overload the service, send spam, or submit anything unlawful or harmful. By sharing a price you agree that it becomes part of the community estimates, which other people see without your name.

sections.title: Your Calculator
paragraphs: The Calculator is a convenience tool: you note the shops you visit (with an optional name), the products you buy, the prices and the quantities, and it adds everything up for you. It is there to help you, not to judge you. To make SOUK-SCAN more useful for everyone, we also learn from how it is used: by using the Calculator you agree that SOUK-SCAN stores the products, prices, quantities and totals you enter, linked to your account, and that the people who run SOUK-SCAN can look at them to keep the service fair and safe (for example against bots, spam and price manipulation), to improve the service and to understand what people buy. You also agree that the prices you enter are shared as community prices. Our reports never include your shop names, we never sell this information or share it with advertisers or other companies, and other users never see your list. We may also use it in combined, anonymous form (for example, average quantities) to improve the app and to produce statistics. The totals are only a convenience: please check the amounts yourself, as SOUK-SCAN is not responsible for errors in them or for decisions based on them. You decide whether to use the Calculator, and deleting your account deletes your lists. Our privacy policy explains this in detail.

sections.title: Keeping prices trustworthy
paragraphs: To keep community prices reliable, we may review, hide or remove submissions that look unreliable or abusive, and we may limit or close accounts that misuse the service. An unusual price is not automatically treated as a wrong one.

sections.title: Limits of the information
paragraphs: Prices change with the place, the market, the quality of the product, the unit and the date. Before an important purchase or decision, please check current prices locally.

sections.title: Availability of the service
paragraphs: We work hard to keep <bdi>SOUK-SCAN</bdi> available and useful, but we cannot promise that it will always run without interruption, be perfectly accurate, or have fresh data for every product. Features and data may change or be unavailable from time to time.

sections.title: Responsibility
paragraphs: To the extent the law allows, <bdi>SOUK-SCAN</bdi> is not responsible for losses that result from relying on incomplete, inaccurate, delayed or unavailable price information. Nothing in these terms limits any right or liability that cannot lawfully be limited.

sections.title: Your account and changes
paragraphs: You can stop using <bdi>SOUK-SCAN</bdi> at any time, and you can delete your account and the data linked to it from Profile (Delete account). We may update the service and these terms. When the terms change in an important way, we will ask you to read and accept the new version before you continue.

sections.title: Applicable law and contact
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco, without affecting any mandatory rights you have as a consumer. For questions, to report a problem, or to ask about your data, use the Feedback form in Profile.

sections.title: Contact
paragraphs: sanamdev@soukscan.online

support.title: Help & support
support.intro: Find help using SOUK-SCAN, understanding price information or managing your account.
support.description: Get help with SOUK-SCAN, regional food prices, location permission, Android installation and account deletion.

sections.title: Prices and regions
paragraphs: Choose a region manually or enable optional automatic detection. Community estimates appear only when sufficient valid reports exist. Wholesale references, where available, show their own source and date and are not retail price guarantees. This website’s interactive scene reads the same public regional estimates and dated wholesale references as the app.

sections.title: Installing and using the app
paragraphs: Install SOUK-SCAN for Android from Google Play. The iOS app is coming soon.

sections.title: Account and data
paragraphs: For account removal, follow the account-deletion instructions. Read our privacy policy and terms of use.

sections.title: Contact SOUK-SCAN
paragraphs: Send a message through Feedback in Profile, or email sanamdev@soukscan.online. Describe the issue and the device or browser you use. Do not include passwords or precise GPS coordinates.
